title: Strong duality for the GROW criterion
summary: This paper presents general strong duality results when testing hypotheses by betting against them. A bet is an e-variable for a composite null hypothesis $\Pcal$: a nonnegative random variable $X$ whose expected value is at most one under every $P \in \mathcal P$. Following Kelly, Breiman, Cover, Shafer, and Grunwald et al. (2024), we study a natural minimax \emph{log-optimality} criterion: given a composite alternative $\Qcal$, we characterize the ``GROW value'' $\sup_{X} \inf_{Q} \E_{Q}[\log X]$.
